description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for user profile operations, including fetching and updating user profiles via HTTP endpoints. It relies on SQLAlchemy for database interactions and includes dependency injection for authentication and database session management.

methods.name: get_user_profile(username: str, db: AsyncSession = Depends(database.get_db))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a user's profile based on username.

methods.name: update_profile( update: schemas.ProfileUpdate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(database.get_db), current_user=Depends(auth_utils.get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update the current user's bio or avatar URL.

ctags.name: get_user_profile
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_user_profile(username: str, db: AsyncSession = Depends(database.get_db)):$/
